items.content: A top executive at data center operator Groq has kicked off an audacious bid to double its valuation in about three months while slamming rivals in the space for being too reliant on debt markets.

items.title: AI Selloff Exposes Data Center Boom Risks
items.content: The selloff in AI stocks is adding new uncertainty to the massive buildout of data centers across the US. Jolienne Halisky, CFO of AIB Data Centers, says financing for new projects could become more expensive and take longer as lenders reassess risk, while permitting, power and chip availability remain constraints. She joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss her company's plans for its first Texas data center, concerns surrounding its anchor tenant Nebius, and why she believes the recent AI market rout will prove temporary. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: AI股票抛售加剧了美国数据中心大规模建设的风险。AIB数据中心首席财务官Jolienne Halisky表示，由于贷款方重新评估风险，新项目融资可能更昂贵且耗时更长，同时许可、电力和芯片供应仍受限。她讨论了公司在德克萨斯州首个数据中心的计划、对核心租户Nebius的担忧，并认为近期AI市场热潮将短暂。融资成本上升、审批及资源限制是主要挑战。(约90字)

She discusses plans for a Texas data center and concerns about anchor tenant Nebius, adding the recent AI market rally is likely temporary. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Time to Move Forward With 'Sensible' AI Regulation, Says Rep. Liccardo
items.content: Democrat Representative from California Sam Liccardo said that congress has 'issued a lot of press releases' on issues surrounding technology, but haven't managed to push meaningful legislation over the finish line. Liccardo, whose district includes parts of Silicon Valley, said it is critical lawmakers act on AI concerns and that it is time to move forward with 'sensible' regulation.  (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Power On: How Private Is an Always-Listening Apple Watch?
items.content:
Apple is bringing some its most ambitious AI capabilities to its products. As AI becomes increasingly woven into daily life, questions over privacy are likely to follow.

On this episode of the Power On podcast, Mark Gurman and Vlad Savov discuss privacy implications of new always-listening Apple Watch features. (Source: Bloomberg)

The conversation highlights potential implications as AI becomes more prevalent. (98 words)

items.title: Data Center Delays Risk an ‘Air Gap’ for Chips: Lovell
items.content: Nadia Lovell, head of global equity strategy at UBS Global Wealth Management, says data center delays could create an “air gap” for semiconductors, pressuring inventories, prices and margins. She favors compute over memory and hyperscalers with existing capacity. She speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 微软正终止与甲骨文公司租赁AI云计算能力的协议，此举是微软对数十亿美元云合作进行重新评估的一部分。
summaries.en: Microsoft is terminating its agreement to rent AI cloud computing capacity from Oracle as part of a broader review of its multi-billion dollar cloud partnerships. The move reflects a strategic shift in how the company approaches its cloud collaborations.

items.title: Jobs Boom Meets AI Market Turmoil
items.content: Get a jump start on the US trading day with Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Open Interest." A blowout jobs report fuels expectations for another Fed rate hike, even as Wall Street reels from a nearly $4 trillion tech selloff and mounting questions about the AI trade. Plus, Anthropic's IPO prospects and valuation reset, BlackRock CIO Rick Rieder explains the AI unwind and emerging credit opportunities, Kevin Hassett, director of the White House National Economic Council, discusses inflation and Fed policy, and Greg Ebel, CEO of Enbridge Energy, weighs in on the growing energy demands of AI infrastructure. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 美国就业市场强劲增长，但科技股暴跌近4万亿美元，引发市场对AI贸易的质疑。美联储加息预期升温，华尔街震荡。Anthropic的IPO前景及估值重估，BlackRock首席投资官Rick Rieder分析AI资产撤出和新兴信贷机会，白宫经济顾问Kevin Hassett讨论通胀与美联储政策，Enbridge能源CEO Greg Ebel指出AI基础设施能耗增长。
summaries.en: A strong US jobs report boosts Fed rate hike expectations amid Wall Street's $4 trillion tech sell-off and AI market turmoil. Key developments include Anthropic's IPO prospects, BlackRock's AI unwind analysis, White House inflation discussions, and Enbridge's AI energy demand insights. (Word count: 50)
